text:
maria: FYI getting 3 customer tickets about p95 regressions after onboarding Zephyr-XL to eu-west dedicated. all long-context calls (>=8k tokens) show big tail, some 500s too.

josh: any common error in logs?

maria: mainly high latency, but a couple of 502/500 tied to kvcache miss storms. here's a condensed user report: "requests hang ~4-8s extra, p99 up to 14s, p95 ~6-8s; only on context>8k; older model ok"

anika: tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. runtime-oncall: can you grab a slowtrace?

runtime-oncall: got a flame from one host, pushing stack now. early sign: GC pauses + repeated cache invalidation on token boundary.

kevin: is this after we switched to the new tokenizer pipeline for Zephyr-XL? we deployed tokenizer-v2 last night to support mixed CJK+emoji.

maria: yes, tokenizer-v2 went live with Zephyr. customers started hitting it after rollouts aligned.

josh: sharing a short repro curl (customer provided):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"zephyr-xl","input":"<very long doc>...","max_tokens":256}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria: repro reliably shows p95 jump when the request contains emoji sequences + mixed scripts.

anika: can you paste the runtime trace snippet?

runtime-oncall: snip from host 10.5.3.12: 
```
[2026-10-12T12:03:21Z] request id=rx8k slowpath enter tokenize -> 62ms
[2026-10-12T12:03:21Z] kvcache invalidation detected: 27 keys evicted
[2026-10-12T12:03:21Z] gc pause 120ms
[2026-10-12T12:03:21Z] request id=rx8k runtime dispatch queued 230ms
[2026-10-12T12:03:21Z] request id=rx8k final gen start
```
\nkevin: 27 key evictions per request is huge. tokenizer-v2 may be producing slightly different token boundaries so prefix-KV cache hits drop and we fall back to warm start.

josh: hypothesis: tokenizer-v2 creates sub-token boundaries that reduce prefix sharing for long docs, causing more per-request memory churn and KV churn -> GC -> tail.

manual: we should roll a quick mitigation: revert tokenizer for Zephyr in eu-west or route long-context traffic to zephyr-quantized variant.

anika: agreed. proposed immediate steps:
- temporarily route context>8k to zephyr-quantized or zephyr-legacy-tokenizer
- disable tokenizer-v2 for new Zephyr instances in eu-west
- raise batch size cap down to avoid large packing that exposes GC
- create an eval set to reproduce mixed CJK+emoji sequences

maria: I've created support ticket INC-6218 linking affected customers. adding workaround: per-customer routing to legacy tokenizer.

support-bot: Ticket INC-6218 created and linked to customers C-3871, C-4022, C-4109. Priority: high.

kevin: eng-ml will run a diff of tokenization on sample problematic docs to see boundary changes. if tokenizer introduces extra small tokens, we can tune BPE merges or postprocess to align with caching keys.

josh: SRE suggestion: evict policy tweak to make prefix cache more forgiving for slightly different boundaries (short-term), but that risks cache blowup.

anika: runtime team — do we have a quick hotfix to avoid GC pauses? maybe tune GC config for the serving process or reduce per-request allocations.

runtime-oncall: can bump GC thresholds on the pool and limit parallelism per host. I'll push a knob change to eu-west pool: reduce max_concurrent = 12 -> 8 and GC_soft_limit +10%. That should shave 100-200ms off tail.

maria: doing routing change now: routing rule deployed to send requests with content_length_tokens>=8000 to zephyr-quantized in eu-west. will monitor.

support-bot: Routing rule applied. Canary: 10% of long-context traffic redirected.

maria: after routing change p95 on canary dropped from 6.5s -> 3.2s in first 20 minutes. p99 also down ~40%. customers on canary reporting improvement.

anika: good. next: eng-ml to run tokenizer diff and propose a backward-compatible tokenizer-v2.

kevin: created branch tokenize-fix/zephyr with a patch that reduces splitting on emoji sequences, will run unit tests and local eval.

josh: action items captured:
- runtime: GC + parallelism knob (INFR-889) — runtime-oncall
- routing revert / quantized route (INFR-890) — maria
- tokenizer diff + patch (ML-301) — kevin
- eval set + long-regression alert (OBS-412) — anika

maria: will update customers and mark as mitigated if metrics hold for 2 hours.

support-bot: Metrics report link: https://console.redwood.ai/obs/ingress/2264209876 (canary dashboard)

josh: please ping here once tokenizer patch lands in staging. we'll keep this thread for the postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks everyone, keeping this thread locked to triage. will reopen if new regressions appear.
